title: Here in East Haddam it's not all @eversource ineptitude. The Gypsy moth and Ash Beetle, coupled with unchecked Asian Bittersweet and grapevine growth
summary: Here in East Haddam it's not all @eversource ineptitude. The Gypsy moth and Ash Beetle, coupled with unchecked Asian Bittersweet and grapevine growth killed so many adolescent trees (150-200 years) But we need water. Fast.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Here in East Haddam it's not all @eversource ineptitude. The Gypsy moth and Ash Beetle, coupled with unchecked Asian Bittersweet and grapevine growth killed so many adolescent trees (150-200 years)

But we need water. Fast.
